data.narrative:
Enfabrica is a Series C semiconductor company founded by Rochan Sankar and Shrijeet Mukherjee that has raised $311.1M to date. Valuation analysis draws on a peer set of 8 private and 3 public comparables in the Chips & Semiconductors sector, including stage-adjacent names like Tenstorrent ($2.7B, Series D), d-Matrix ($2.0B, Series C), and DEEPX ($529M, Series C).

Two triangulation methods apply. Stage-progression analysis, anchoring to the $311.1M total raised as a valuation proxy and applying a 1.7x step-up multiplier typical of Series C advancement, implies $529M. Peer-median analysis across four same-sector, same/adjacent-stage comparables yields $1.5B, with a range spanning $529M to $2.7B. Public company P/S anchoring (median 21.0x across ALAB, NVDA, AMD) cannot be applied due to absent revenue disclosure, typical for private companies at this stage.

The two applicable methods produce a triangulated range of $450M (low) to $1.7B (high), with a median of $1.0B. The wide spread reflects genuine uncertainty in early-stage semiconductor valuations, where stage progression and peer multiples diverge substantially. Key uncertainties include whether Enfabrica's technical position and go-to-market align with higher-valued peers like d-Matrix or lower-valued ones like DEEPX, and the timing and scale of revenue inflection—currently unknowable from available data.
